description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 05.09.2016 to 11.09.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter. The content involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs payments.
